Short_Description: Command: Enemy within 18" takes Battle-shock at -1. Failed = -1 To Hit until next turn.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to and within 18" of your unit. That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from that test and, if that test is failed, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Short_Description: Shoot/Fight: LETHAL HITS or SUSTAINED HITS 1 after DROP POD disembark OR vs target within 12".
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have this ability in a turn in which they disembarked from a DROP POD or while targeting an enemy unit within 12".
Tag Categories: [Melee - Weapon Rules] [Range - Weapon Rules] [Melee - Weapon Rules] [Range - Weapon Rules]

Short_Description: Shoot/Fight: PRECISION and +1 TO HIT vs CHARACTER.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
Tag Categories: [Melee - Combat Modifiers] [Range - Combat Modifiers] [Melee - Weapon Rules] [Range - Weapon Rules]

Short_Description: Enemy Shoot: Target + nearby SMOKE VEHICLE/DROP POD get Stealth and Cover.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES SMOKE VEHICLE or DROP POD unit within 9" of it.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your units have the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets one of your units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Short_Description: Fight: Pile-in and Consolidation moves up to 6".
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Short_Description: End enemy Fight: INFANTRY wholly within 6" of TRANSPORT can embark.
Long_Description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was not set up on the battlefield this turn and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.

EFFECT: If your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Short_Description: Command: below Starting Strength; ignore characteristic, roll, and test modifiers except saving throws until end of turn.
Long_Description: WHEN: Command phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit below Starting Strength. EFFECT: Until end of turn, that unit can ignore modifiers to its characteristics and to rolls or tests made for it, except modifiers to saving throws.

Short_Description: Opponent Shooting/Fight: targeted ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit worsens incoming AP by 1.
Long_Description: WHEN: Opponent Shooting phase or Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected as a target. EFFECT: Until that attacking unit finishes its attacks, worsen the AP of attacks targeting your unit by 1.

Short_Description: Shooting/Fight: vs below Starting Strength gain SUSTAINED HITS 1; VEHICLE Critical Hits on unmodified 5+.
Long_Description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that has not shot or fought this phase. EFFECT: Against targets below Starting Strength, attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; VEHICLE attacks also score Critical Hits on successful unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
Tag Categories: [Melee - Weapon Rules] [Range - Weapon Rules] [Melee - Weapon Rules] [Range - Weapon Rules]

Short_Description: Destroyed VEHICLE with Deadly Demise: automatically inflict its Deadly Demise mortal wounds.
Long_Description: WHEN: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE with Deadly Demise is destroyed. TARGET: That destroyed model. EFFECT: Do not roll to see whether Deadly Demise triggers; its mortal wounds are inflicted automatically.

Short_Description: Command: WALKER gets +1 Move, Toughness, Leadership, OC and +1 TO HIT until next Command.
Long_Description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER model. EFFECT: Until your next Command phase, improve Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control by 1, and add 1 to Hit rolls for its attacks.

Short_Description: Opponent Shooting: VEHICLE reduced below Half-strength can shoot back only at the attacker.
Long_Description: WHEN: Opponent Shooting phase, after an enemy unit resolves its attacks. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit reduced to Below Half-strength by those attacks. EFFECT: That unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but only at that enemy unit and only if it is an eligible target.

Short_Description:
Enemy SHOOTING / FIGHT
When targeted: Attacks against this unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Short_Description:
COMMAND phase
Select different doctrine
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

Short_Description: Fight on Death 4+
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Short_Description: RANGED: IGNORES COVER
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Short_Description: MELEE: LANCE
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

Short_Description:
Enemy MOVEMENT within 8”
INFANTRY / MOUNTED
Reactive Move D6”
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

Attacks: -1 AP

WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Short_Description:
FIGHT: MELEE have LANCE
In ASSAULT: LANCE & +1 AP

WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have:
• [LANCE].
• Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [LANCE] and +1 AP.

Short_Description:
Fight on Death 4+
In ASSAULT: Fight on Death 3+
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Short_Description:
SHOOTING: Enemy hit is SUPPRESSED
SUPPRESSED: -1 to Hit until your next turn
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
• While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

Short_Description:
INFANTRY / MOUNTED only
Enemy ends move within 8": Move D6"
In TACTICAL: Move 6"
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

Enemy SHOOTING / FIGHT
Attacks: -1 AP
Long_Description:

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Short_Description:
SHOOTING: RANGED IGNORE COVER
In DEVASTATOR: IGNORE COVER & +1 AP

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
• [IGNORES COVER].
• Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [IGNORES COVER] and +1 AP.

Short_Description:
Enemy SHOOTING destroys a model
Shoot back at that enemy unit
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

Short_Description:
Enemy SHOOTING / FIGHT
TERMINATOR: Attacks -1 D
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

Short_Description:
TERMINATOR SHOOTING
RANGED: LETHAL HITS & SUSTAINED HITS 1
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description:
End of enemy FIGHT
Unengaged TERMINATOR: STRATEGIC RESERVES
Long_Description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

TACTICUS SHOOTING / FIGHT
vs non-MONSTER / VEHICLE: SUSTAINED HITS 1
vs MONSTER / VEHICLE: LETHAL HITS
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
• Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Short_Description:
TACTICUS on OBJECTIVE
After enemy fights: FIGHTS FIRST & fight next
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

Short_Description: TACTICUS CONSOLIDATE: D3+3\"
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".
